comparison.objective: Candidate finishes four inserts; record relays a frozen sample vial between cold boxes within a time limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual impact tooling and fragment search/recovery; record requires cross-workspace handoff through an intermediate pad and rapid cold-chain transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures and all tangs contained; record requires transfer within 20 seconds for full credit, with 30- and 45-second partial thresholds.
comparison.reason: Timed bimanual sample relay tests reach and handoff planning, not fracture mechanics.
